physical_metadata_digest_law.statement: A physical-metadata digest is valid only for the pair (source identity, exact reader lane).

physical_metadata_digest_law.cause: reader_configuration carrying encoding and authority_status is inside the digest payload.
physical_metadata_digest_law.repeat_stability: Decode is repeatable within a lane (two runs bit-identical).
physical_metadata_digest_law.run_requirement: Every recorded physical-metadata digest MUST be published together with its reader lane. A digest without its lane is an incomplete record.
